native_update: resultsmech.f1043–1080 accumulates trapezoidal stre:delta(emec) over actual accepted increments, including intervals omitted by output FREQUENCY. It updates mechanical strain after removing the thermal strain through calcmechstrain.
stress_measure: The stre/skl stress used in this update is the material/reference (second Piola-Kirchhoff) stress, before the explicit Cauchy push-forward at resultsmech.f1199–1242.
volume_measure: Reference-volume density for this material-conjugate mechanical work; integration uses undeformed isoparametric determinant weights. Units Nmm/mm3, numerically MPa, and integral Nmm.
elastic_plastic_scope: Cumulative native mechanical work includes the elastic and irreversible plastic contributions of the path; no separate elastic stored-energy/plastic-dissipation decomposition is exported or inferred.
not_claimed: Total thermodynamic internal energy with caloric temperature energy
trigger: ENER requested in the first mechanical step and retained in every subsequent step; complete eight true IP values exported through EL PRINT.
